arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case argue federal law bars state exhaustion defenses. They cite precedent holding failure to exhaust is not a valid defense.
the opposing sides argue federal law does not preempt neutral state rules. They cite precedent allowing states to apply valid jurisdictional rules.
Chief Justice Roberts questioned the objection to the exhaustion requirement. He noted it simply imposes a delay.
Justice Barrett asked why the sides that brought the case chose state court. She also inquired about the state statute of limitations.
